parsed.rationale: Both participating records are test/mock fixtures. The first record lives at 'Shared/PartyHorn/Tests/PartyHornTests/SoundPlayerTests.swift' (a test file) and the second at 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift' (explicitly under a Mocks directory). Both are intentional test doubles scoped to their respective test targets; consolidating them would couple unrelated test packages and risk leaking test semantics into shared production code. No structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, differing_slots) was provided to substantiate a meaningful overlap, further undermining any action case.
